name: 99352 · Richland, WA
findings: ZIP 99352 (Richland) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99352 (Richland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99352 (Richland) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
